Migration guide:

# google-generativeai -> google-genai

google-generativeai (the SDK behind `import google.generativeai as genai`) is no longer
supported: Google ended support on 2025-11-30 and archived its repository. Its replacement is
google-genai (`from google import genai`), with a different, client-based API.

Only the Gemini Developer API (an API key) is migrated here. Vertex AI mode
(`genai.Client(vertexai=True, ...)`, `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI`), the Files API, context
caching, tuning, operations, automatic function calling with Python callables, and the
PaLM-era functions (`genai.generate_text`, `genai.chat`, `genai.generate_embeddings`) are out of
scope: leave them alone, and report them in the summary rather than guessing at a fix.

## Client

`genai.configure(api_key=X)` becomes `client = genai.Client(api_key=X)`. Build the client where
it is used, not at import time: the old `configure()` could be called with no key yet (the key
was only needed later, at the first call); `genai.Client()` raises immediately if no key is
available, so building one at import time breaks code that used to defer this.

Keep the repo's own function signatures and return shapes where you can: if a function used to
return a `GenerativeModel` (or a response, or a dict), its callers and the tests that patch it
depend on that. Where the new SDK has no equivalent object, return the least different thing
(for example a small wrapper holding the client and the model name, with the methods the callers
use) rather than changing what callers receive; when a signature or return shape must change,
update every caller you were given and say so in the summary.

Never drop a key value: whatever key the old code gave `configure()` must reach the new client.

When `configure(api_key=X)` gets the repo's own key, pass that same expression to
`genai.Client(api_key=X)` and keep how the repo reads it exactly as written: the same variable
names, the same order, the same fallbacks. If the repo reads `os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY")`,
the rewrite reads that and only that. Do not add `GEMINI_API_KEY` or any other fallback, and do
not rebuild the key expression.

## Models and calls

There is no model object in the new SDK. `GenerativeModel(name, system_instruction=...,
generation_config=..., safety_settings=..., tools=..., tool_config=...)` becomes: keep the model
name (add a `models/` prefix is not needed, the new SDK does it itself), and move every one of
those keywords (plus every field of a `GenerationConfig`) into a single
`types.GenerateContentConfig(...)` passed on each call. A class that kept `self.model =
GenerativeModel(...)` keeps `self.client` and `self.model_name` plus one shared config built
once.

- `<model>.generate_content(c, ...)` -> `client.models.generate_content(model=name, contents=c,
  config=types.GenerateContentConfig(...))`
- `<model>.count_tokens(c)` -> `client.models.count_tokens(model=name, contents=c)`
- `genai.list_models()` -> `client.models.list()`; `genai.get_model(name)` ->
  `client.models.get(model=name)`

Dropping one of the moved keywords silently changes behaviour (a missing `system_instruction`,
a missing `safety_settings` entry): carry every one of them into the config.

## Responses

`.text` returns `None` instead of raising `ValueError` when there is no text (a blocked prompt,
a function-call-only response): change a `try: ... except ValueError:` around it into a `None`
check. Keep the `raise` and its message, and keep any safety / `finish_reason` handling. The
`from e` goes with the removed `except` clause (nothing is left to chain from); every other
`raise ... from e` stays as it is:

```python
# before
try:
    text = response.text
except ValueError as e:
    raise GeminiError("response blocked") from e

# after
text = response.text
if text is None:
    raise GeminiError("response blocked")
```

`usage_metadata` keeps the same field names (`prompt_token_count`,
`candidates_token_count`, `total_token_count`). `response.resolve()` is gone (iterate the stream
to completion instead); `response.to_dict()` is `response.model_dump()`;
`Model.supported_generation_methods` is renamed `supported_actions`.

## Safety settings

Old shapes (a dict `{HarmCategory.HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT: HarmBlockThreshold.BLOCK_NONE}`, a
list of such dicts, or shorthand strings like `{"harassment": "block_none"}`) all become a list
of `types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT", threshold="BLOCK_NONE")`. Keep
every category and threshold exactly as it was — the string enum values are the same names,
upper-cased (`"harassment"` -> `HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT`, `"block_none"` -> `BLOCK_NONE`), but
nothing besides the old shorthand `"harassment"`-style strings still works, so always write out
the enum name.

## Errors

`genai.types.BlockedPromptException`, `StopCandidateException`, `IncompleteIterationError` and
`BrokenResponseError` are gone: check `response.prompt_feedback.block_reason` or
`candidates[0].finish_reason` instead of catching an exception.

`google.api_core.exceptions.*` (raised by the old SDK's transport) have no equivalent in the new
one, which never raises them and does not depend on google-api-core at all:
`ResourceExhausted` / `InvalidArgument` / `PermissionDenied` / `Unauthenticated` / `NotFound` /
`FailedPrecondition` -> `google.genai.errors.ClientError` (check `e.code` for the HTTP status,
e.g. 429 for a quota error); `DeadlineExceeded` / `ServiceUnavailable` / `InternalServerError`
-> `google.genai.errors.ServerError`; `GoogleAPICallError` / `GoogleAPIError` ->
`google.genai.errors.APIError` (the common base, 4xx and 5xx alike). This applies to
tests too (a test that raises or expects `google_exceptions.ResourceExhausted` raises or expects
`errors.ClientError(429, {...})`), and to the `google.api_core` imports themselves: google-genai
no longer installs google-api-core, so a file that still imports it fails to import unless the
repo declares google-api-core (apifix reports any such import as a finding, and a rewrite that
keeps one is rejected). Keep `google.api_core` only where the repo declares google-api-core and
the file uses it for something besides the Gemini calls (another Google client, or retries on
the exception types themselves rather than catching them).

`ResourceExhausted` -> `ClientError` also catches the other 4xx codes, so keep the handler body
as it is and guard on the code at the top of the clause, never around part of the body (wrapping
and re-indenting part of it moves statements into other branches and leaves variables unset):

```python
except errors.ClientError as e:
    if e.code != 429:
        raise
    <the original ResourceExhausted body, unchanged>
```

Do not change retry loops. Only the exception class names change
(`google_exceptions.X` -> `errors.ClientError` / `errors.ServerError` / `errors.APIError`);
the loop, its guards (attempt counts, which errors retry) and its waits (`time.sleep(...)`,
backoff) stay exactly as written.

## Tests

Patch `pkg.mod.genai.Client`, not `genai.configure` or `genai.GenerativeModel` (those attributes
no longer exist on the module, so a leftover patch of them fails well into the test run, not at
collection). This holds for string targets too: `patch("pkg.mod.genai.GenerativeModel")`,
`patch("google.generativeai.configure")` and `monkeypatch.setattr("pkg.mod.genai.configure",
...)` name attributes the new module lacks. Set `Client.return_value.models.generate_content.return_value` (or `.chats.create`,
`.models.embed_content`). Never patch the client class with `autospec=True`: its resources
(`models`, `chats`, `aio`, ...) are properties, which autospec does not follow, leaving a mock
without them. A mock response is `MagicMock(text="...")`, or a real
`types.GenerateContentResponse(candidates=[types.Candidate(content=types.Content(role="model",
parts=[types.Part(text="...")]))])`. Simulate an error with
`errors.ClientError(429, {"error": {"code": 429, "message": "quota", "status":
"RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}})`. A `sys.modules["google.generativeai"]` stub becomes a stub of
`google.genai`; `monkeypatch.setenv("GEMINI_API_KEY", ...)` keeps working (the new SDK reads it
too, as a fallback).

```python
        """Get supported models from config."""
        return self._config.get_supported_models("gemini")

    def generate(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_tokens: int = 1000,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
    ) -> LLMResponse:
        """Generate text using Google Gemini API.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt to send to the LLM
            model: The model name (must be one of SUPPORTED_MODELS)
            max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0)

        Returns:
            LLMResponse containing the generated text, token usage, and latency

        Raises:
            ValueError: If model is not supported or parameters are invalid
            RuntimeError: If the API call fails after retries
        """
        # Validate model
        if model not in self.SUPPORTED_MODELS:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unsupported model: {model}. Supported models: {', '.join(self.SUPPORTED_MODELS)}"
            )

        # Validate parameters
        if max_tokens < 1:
            raise ValueError("max_tokens must be at least 1")
        if not 0.0 <= temperature <= 2.0:
            raise ValueError("temperature must be between 0.0 and 2.0")

        start_time = time.time()

        try:
            # Make API call with retry logic
            response = self._call_with_retry(
                prompt=prompt,
                model=model,
                max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
                temperature=temperature,
            )

            # Extract response data
            # Handle cases where response was blocked by safety filters
            text = ""
            if hasattr(response, "text"):
                text = response.text
```
```python
                if text is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("Google Gemini API returned no text")

            # Get token usage from response
            tokens_used = 0
            if hasattr(response, "usage_metadata"):
                usage = response.usage_metadata
```
```python
                tokens_used = (usage.prompt_token_count or 0) + (usage.candidates_token_count or 0)
            elif hasattr(response, "usage"):
                # Fallback for different response formats
                usage = response.usage
                tokens_used = (getattr(usage, "prompt_token_count", 0) or 0) + (
                    getattr(usage, "candidates_token_count", 0) or 0
                )

            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000

            return LLMResponse(
                text=text,
                tokens_used=tokens_used,
                latency_ms=latency_ms,
            )
```

```python
        except errors.APIError as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Google Gemini API error: {e}") from e
        except Exception as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected error calling Google Gemini API: {e}") from e

    def _call_with_retry(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_output_tokens: int,
        temperature: float,
        max_retries: int = 3,
    ) -> types.GenerateContentResponse:
        """Call Google Gemini API with exponential backoff retry logic.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt
            model: The model name
            max_output_tokens: Maximum tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature
            max_retries: Maximum number of retry attempts

        Returns:
            Google Gemini API response object

        Raises:
            errors.APIError: If API call fails after all retries
        """
        # Prepare safety settings using the new SDK types
        safety_settings = [
            types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT", threshold="BLOCK_NONE"),
            types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH", threshold="BLOCK_NONE"),
            types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT", threshold="BLOCK_NONE"),
            types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT", threshold="BLOCK_NONE"),
        ]

        last_exception: Exception | None = None

        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            try:
                # Generate content using the client model API
                response = self._client.models.generate_content(
                    model=model,
                    contents=prompt,
                    config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
                        generation_config=types.GenerationConfig(
                            max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens,
                            temperature=temperature,
                        ),
                        safety_settings=safety_settings,
                    ),
                )
                return response

            except errors.ClientError as e:
                # Rate limit (429) handling
                if e.code == 429:
                    retry_after = None
                    if hasattr(e, "response") and e.response:
                        headers = getattr(e.response, "headers", {})
                        retry_after = headers.get("Retry-After") if headers else None

                    if retry_after:
                        wait_time = float(retry_after)
                    else:
                        wait_time = 2**attempt  # Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s

                    if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                        time.sleep(wait_time)
                        last_exception = e
                        continue
                    raise

                # Authentication errors (401, 403) – do not retry
                if e.code in (401, 403):
                    raise

                # Other client errors – retry
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

            except errors.ServerError as e:
                # Timeout or service unavailable – retry
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

            except errors.APIError as e:
                # Other API errors – retry
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

        # If we get here, all retries failed
        if last_exception:
            raise last_exception
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to call Google Gemini API after retries")
```

```python
        return self._config.get_supported_models("gemini")

        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_tokens: int = 1000,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
    ) -> LLMResponse:
        """Generate text using Google Gemini API.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt to send to the LLM
            model: The model name (must be one of SUPPORTED_MODELS)
            max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0)

        Returns:
            LLMResponse containing the generated text, token usage, and latency

        Raises:
            ValueError: If model is not supported or parameters are invalid
            RuntimeError: If the API call fails after retries
        """

        if model not in self.SUPPORTED_MODELS:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unsupported model: {model}. Supported models: {', '.join(self.SUPPORTED_MODELS)}"
            )

        # Validate parameters
        if max_tokens < 1:
            raise ValueError("max_tokens must be at least 1")
        if not 0.0 <= temperature <= 2.0:
            raise ValueError("temperature must be between 0.0 and 2.0")

        start_time = time.time()

        try:
            # Make API call with retry logic
            response = self._call_with_retry(
                prompt=prompt,
                model=model,
                max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
                temperature=temperature,
            )

            # Extract response data
            # Handle cases where response was blocked by safety filters
            text = ""
            if hasattr(response, "text"):
                try:
```
                    text = response.text
```python
                except ValueError as e:
                    # Response was blocked (finish_reason: SAFETY) or has no content
                    # Check finish_reason for more details
                    if hasattr(response, "candidates") and response.candidates:
                        candidate = response.candidates[0]
                        finish_reason = getattr(candidate, "finish_reason", None)
                        if finish_reason == 2 or (

                                "Try adjusting the prompt or safety settings."
                            ) from e
                    # Re-raise if it's a different error
                    raise

            tokens_used = 0
            if hasattr(response, "usage_metadata"):
                usage = response.usage_metadata
                tokens_used = (usage.prompt_token_count or 0) + (usage.candidates_token_count or 0)
            elif hasattr(response, "usage"):
                # Fallback for different response formats
                usage = response.usage
                tokens_used = (getattr(usage, "prompt_token_count", 0) or 0) + (
                    getattr(usage, "candidates_token_count", 0) or 0
                )

            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000

            return LLMResponse(
                text=text,
                tokens_used=tokens_used,
                latency_ms=latency_ms,
            )

        except google_exceptions.GoogleAPIError as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Google Gemini API error: {e}") from e
        except Exception as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected error calling Google Gemini API: {e}") from e

    def _call_with_retry(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_output_tokens: int,
        temperature: float,
        max_retries: int = 3,
    ) -> GenerateContentResponse:
        """Call Google Gemini API with exponential backoff retry logic.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt
            model: The model name
            max_output_tokens: Maximum tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature
            max_retries: Maximum number of retry attempts

        Returns:
            Google Gemini API response object

        Raises:
            google_exceptions.GoogleAPIError: If API call fails after all retries
        """
        last_exception: Exception | None = None

        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            try:
                # Create model instance with safety settings
                # Use lenient safety settings for testing/development
                safety_settings = [
                    {
                        "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },
                    {
                        "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH",
                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },
                    {
                        "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT",
                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },
                    {
                        "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT",
                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },
                ]

                gemini_model = genai.GenerativeModel(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                    model,
                    safety_settings=safety_settings,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                )

                # Generate content
                response = gemini_model.generate_content(
                    prompt,
                    generation_config={
                        "max_output_tokens": max_output_tokens,
                        "temperature": temperature,
                    },
                )
                return response

            except google_exceptions.ResourceExhausted as e:
                # Rate limit error (429) - check for Retry-After header
                retry_after = None
                if hasattr(e, "response") and e.response:
                    headers = getattr(e.response, "headers", {})
                    retry_after = headers.get("Retry-After") if headers else None

                if retry_after:
                    wait_time = float(retry_after)
                else:
                    # Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s
                    wait_time = 2**attempt

                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

            except (
                google_exceptions.DeadlineExceeded,
                google_exceptions.ServiceUnavailable,
            ) as e:
                # Timeout or service unavailable - retry with exponential backoff
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt  # 1s, 2s, 4s
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

            except (
                google_exceptions.Unauthenticated,
                google_exceptions.PermissionDenied,
            ):
                # Authentication errors - don't retry
                raise

            except google_exceptions.GoogleAPIError as e:
                # Other API errors - retry with exponential backoff
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
```

```python
This module implements the Gemini provider using the Google Generative AI SDK directly.
Supported models are loaded from config file.
Reference: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models

Note: google.generativeai is deprecated in favor of google.genai.

import time
import warnings

# Suppress deprecation warning for google.generativeai package at import time
# This package works but is deprecated in favor of google.genai
# Migration tracked in implementation plan section 5.0.4
with warnings.catch_warnings():
```

```python
from google.api_core import exceptions as google_exceptions
from google.generativeai.types import GenerateContentResponse

from src.config.llm_config import get_llm_config
from src.llm.provider import LLMProvider, LLMResponse


class GeminiProvider(LLMProvider):
    """Google Gemini LLM provider implementation.

    Uses the Google Generative AI SDK to make API calls. Supports retry logic and
    error handling for timeouts, rate limits, and authentication errors.

    Supported models are loaded from config file (config/config.json).
    """

    def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Initialize Gemini provider.

        Args:
            api_key: Google API key. If None, reads from .env file or GOOGLE_API_KEY env var.
                    Priority: explicit api_key > .env file > environment variable.
        """
        self._api_key = self._load_api_key(api_key, "GOOGLE_API_KEY", "Google")

        genai.configure(api_key=self._api_key)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        self._config = get_llm_config()

    @property
    def SUPPORTED_MODELS(self) -> set[str]:
        """Get supported models from config."""
        return self._config.get_supported_models("gemini")

    def generate(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_tokens: int = 1000,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
    ) -> LLMResponse:
        """Generate text using Google Gemini API.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt to send to the LLM
            model: The model name (must be one of SUPPORTED_MODELS)
            max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0)

        Returns:
            LLMResponse containing the generated text, token usage, and latency

        Raises:
            ValueError: If model is not supported or parameters are invalid
            RuntimeError: If the API call fails after retries
        """
        # Validate model
        if model not in self.SUPPORTED_MODELS:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unsupported model: {model}. Supported models: {', '.join(self.SUPPORTED_MODELS)}"
            )

        # Validate parameters
        if max_tokens < 1:
            raise ValueError("max_tokens must be at least 1")
        if not 0.0 <= temperature <= 2.0:
            raise ValueError("temperature must be between 0.0 and 2.0")

        start_time = time.time()

        try:

            response = self._call_with_retry(
                prompt=prompt,
                model=model,
                max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
                temperature=temperature,
            )

            # Extract response data

            text = ""
            if hasattr(response, "text"):
                try:
                    text = response.text
                except ValueError as e:
                    # Response was blocked (finish_reason: SAFETY) or has no content
                    # Check finish_reason for more details
                    if hasattr(response, "candidates") and response.candidates:
                        candidate = response.candidates[0]
                        finish_reason = getattr(candidate, "finish_reason", None)
                        if finish_reason == 2 or (
                            isinstance(finish_reason, str) and "SAFETY" in finish_reason.upper()
                        ):
                            raise RuntimeError(
                                "Google Gemini API blocked the response due to safety filters. "
                                "Try adjusting the prompt or safety settings."
                            ) from e
                    # Re-raise if it's a different error
                    raise

            # Get token usage from response
            tokens_used = 0
            if hasattr(response, "usage_metadata"):
                usage = response.usage_metadata
                tokens_used = (usage.prompt_token_count or 0) + (usage.candidates_token_count or 0)
            elif hasattr(response, "usage"):
                # Fallback for different response formats
                usage = response.usage
                tokens_used = (getattr(usage, "prompt_token_count", 0) or 0) + (
                    getattr(usage, "candidates_token_count", 0) or 0
                )

            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000

            return LLMResponse(
                text=text,
                tokens_used=tokens_used,
                latency_ms=latency_ms,
            )

        except google_exceptions.GoogleAPIError as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Google Gemini API error: {e}") from e
        except Exception as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected error calling Google Gemini API: {e}") from e

    def _call_with_retry(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_output_tokens: int,
        temperature: float,
        max_retries: int = 3,
    ) -> GenerateContentResponse:
        """Call Google Gemini API with exponential backoff retry logic.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt
            model: The model name
            max_output_tokens: Maximum tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature
            max_retries: Maximum number of retry attempts

                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },

                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",

                    retry_after = headers.get("Retry-After") if headers else None

                if retry_after:
                    wait_time = float(retry_after)
                else:

                    wait_time = 2**attempt

                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue

            except (
                google_exceptions.DeadlineExceeded,
                google_exceptions.ServiceUnavailable,
            ) as e:
                # Timeout or service unavailable - retry with exponential backoff
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt  # 1s, 2s, 4s
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
```

```python
"""Tests for Gemini provider (Phase 5.0.4).

Tests verify that GeminiProvider correctly implements the LLMProvider interface,
supports Gemini 3 Flash model, and handles errors appropriately.
"""

import os

import pytest

class TestGeminiProviderInterface:
    """Test GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""

    def test_gemini_provider_implements_llm_provider(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert isinstance(provider, GeminiProvider)

    def test_gemini_provider_has_generate_method(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider has generate() method."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert hasattr(provider, "generate")
            assert callable(provider.generate)

        """Test initialization with explicit API key."""
        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key-123")
        assert provider._api_key == "test-key-123"
        mock_configure.assert_called_once_with(api_key="test-key-123")

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
```

```python
"""Tests for Gemini provider (Phase 5.0.4).

Tests verify that GeminiProvider correctly implements the LLMProvider interface,
supports Gemini 3 Flash model, and handles errors appropriately.
"""

import os
```
```python
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, Mock, PropertyMock, patch

import google.api_core.exceptions as google_exceptions
import pytest

from src.llm.gemini_provider import GeminiProvider
from src.llm.provider import LLMResponse


class TestGeminiProviderInterface:
    """Test GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""

    def test_gemini_provider_implements_llm_provider(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert isinstance(provider, GeminiProvider)

    def test_gemini_provider_has_generate_method(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider has generate() method."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert hasattr(provider, "generate")
            assert callable(provider.generate)


class TestGeminiProviderInitialization:
    """Test GeminiProvider initialization."""

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_initialization_with_api_key(self, mock_configure: MagicMock) -> None:
        """Test initialization with explicit API key."""
        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key-123")
        assert provider._api_key == "test-key-123"
        mock_configure.assert_called_once_with(api_key="test-key-123")

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_initialization_with_env_var(self, mock_configure: MagicMock) -> None:
        """Test initialization reads API key from environment variable."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "env-key-456"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert provider._api_key == "env-key-456"
            mock_configure.assert_called_once_with(api_key="env-key-456")

    def test_initialization_fails_without_api_key(self) -> None:
        """Test initialization fails when no API key provided."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Google API key is required"):
                GeminiProvider()


class TestGeminiProviderGenerate:
    """Test GeminiProvider.generate() method."""

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")

    ) -> None:

        # Setup mock response

        mock_response.text = "Test response"
        mock_response.usage_metadata = Mock(prompt_token_count=50, candidates_token_count=50)

        mock_model = Mock()
        mock_model.generate_content.return_value = mock_response
        mock_generative_model.return_value = mock_model

        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key")
        response = provider.generate(
            prompt="Test prompt",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            max_tokens=100,
            temperature=0.7,
        )

        # Verify API was called correctly
        # Note: safety_settings are now included to prevent false positive safety blocks
        mock_generative_model.assert_called_once()
        call_args = mock_generative_model.call_args
        assert call_args[0][0] == "gemini-2.5-flash"  # First positional arg is model name
        assert "safety_settings" in call_args[1]  # Keyword arg for safety settings

        mock_model.generate_content.assert_called_once_with(
            "Test prompt",
            generation_config={"max_output_tokens": 100, "temperature": 0.7},
        )

        # Verify response
        assert isinstance(response, LLMResponse)
        assert response.text == "Test response"
        assert response.tokens_used == 100  # prompt + candidates
        assert response.latency_ms > 0
```

```python
"""Tests for Gemini provider (Phase 5.0.4).

Tests verify that GeminiProvider correctly implements the LLMProvider interface,
supports Gemini 3 Flash model, and handles errors appropriately.
"""

import os
```
```python
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, Mock, PropertyMock, patch

import google.api_core.exceptions as google_exceptions
import pytest

from src.llm.gemini_provider import GeminiProvider
from src.llm.provider import LLMResponse


class TestGeminiProviderInterface:
    """Test GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""

    def test_gemini_provider_implements_llm_provider(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert isinstance(provider, GeminiProvider)

    def test_gemini_provider_has_generate_method(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider has generate() method."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert hasattr(provider, "generate")
            assert callable(provider.generate)


class TestGeminiProviderInitialization:
    """Test GeminiProvider initialization."""

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_initialization_with_api_key(self, mock_configure: MagicMock) -> None:
        """Test initialization with explicit API key."""
        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key-123")
        assert provider._api_key == "test-key-123"
        mock_configure.assert_called_once_with(api_key="test-key-123")

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_initialization_with_env_var(self, mock_configure: MagicMock) -> None:
        """Test initialization reads API key from environment variable."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "env-key-456"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert provider._api_key == "env-key-456"
            mock_configure.assert_called_once_with(api_key="env-key-456")

    def test_initialization_fails_without_api_key(self) -> None:
        """Test initialization fails when no API key provided."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Google API key is required"):
                GeminiProvider()


class TestGeminiProviderGenerate:
    """Test GeminiProvider.generate() method."""

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.GenerativeModel")
    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")

        # Setup mock response
        mock_response = Mock()
        mock_response.text = "Test response"
        mock_response.usage_metadata = Mock(prompt_token_count=50, candidates_token_count=50)

        mock_model = Mock()
        mock_model.generate_content.return_value = mock_response
        mock_generative_model.return_value = mock_model

        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key")
        response = provider.generate(
            prompt="Test prompt",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            max_tokens=100,
            temperature=0.7,
        )

        # Verify API was called correctly
        # Note: safety_settings are now included to prevent false positive safety blocks
        mock_generative_model.assert_called_once()
        call_args = mock_generative_model.call_args
        assert call_args[0][0] == "gemini-2.5-flash"  # First positional arg is model name
        assert "safety_settings" in call_args[1]  # Keyword arg for safety settings

        mock_model.generate_content.assert_called_once_with(
            "Test prompt",
            generation_config={"max_output_tokens": 100, "temperature": 0.7},
        )

        assert isinstance(response, LLMResponse)
        assert response.text == "Test response"
        assert response.tokens_used == 100  # prompt + candidates
        assert response.latency_ms > 0
```

```python
"""Tests for Gemini provider (Phase 5.0.4).

Tests verify that GeminiProvider correctly implements the LLMProvider interface,
supports Gemini 3 Flash model, and handles errors appropriately.
"""

import os
```
```python
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, Mock, PropertyMock, patch

import google.api_core.exceptions as google_exceptions
import pytest

from src.llm.gemini_provider import GeminiProvider
from src.llm.provider import LLMResponse


class TestGeminiProviderInterface:
    """Test GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""

    def test_gemini_provider_implements_llm_provider(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert isinstance(provider, GeminiProvider)

    def test_gemini_provider_has_generate_method(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider has generate() method."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert hasattr(provider, "generate")
            assert callable(provider.generate)


class TestGeminiProviderInitialization:
    """Test GeminiProvider initialization."""

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_initialization_with_api_key(self, mock_configure: MagicMock) -> None:
        """Test initialization with explicit API key."""
        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key-123")
        assert provider._api_key == "test-key-123"
        mock_configure.assert_called_once_with(api_key="test-key-123")

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_initialization_with_env_var(self, mock_configure: MagicMock) -> None:
        """Test initialization reads API key from environment variable."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "env-key-456"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert provider._api_key == "env-key-456"
            mock_configure.assert_called_once_with(api_key="env-key-456")

    def test_initialization_fails_without_api_key(self) -> None:
        """Test initialization fails when no API key provided."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Google API key is required"):
                GeminiProvider()


class TestGeminiProviderGenerate:
    """Test GeminiProvider.generate() method."""

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.GenerativeModel")
    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_generate_calls_gemini_api_with_correct_parameters(
        self, mock_configure: MagicMock, mock_generative_model: MagicMock
    ) -> None:
        """Test that generate() calls Gemini API with correct parameters."""
        # Setup mock response
        mock_response = Mock()
        mock_response.text = "Test response"
        mock_response.usage_metadata = Mock(prompt_token_count=50, candidates_token_count=50)

        mock_model = Mock()
        mock_model.generate_content.return_value = mock_response
        mock_generative_model.return_value = mock_model

        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key")
        response = provider.generate(
            prompt="Test prompt",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            max_tokens=100,
            temperature=0.7,
        )

        # Verify API was called correctly
        # Note: safety_settings are now included to prevent false positive safety blocks
        mock_generative_model.assert_called_once()
        call_args = mock_generative_model.call_args
        assert call_args[0][0] == "gemini-2.5-flash"  # First positional arg is model name
        assert "safety_settings" in call_args[1]  # Keyword arg for safety settings

        mock_model.generate_content.assert_called_once_with(
            "Test prompt",
            generation_config={"max_output_tokens": 100, "temperature": 0.7},
        )

        # Verify response
        assert isinstance(response, LLMResponse)
        assert response.text == "Test response"
        assert response.tokens_used == 100  # prompt + candidates
        assert response.latency_ms > 0

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.GenerativeModel")
    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_generate_supports_gemini_3_flash_preview_model(
        self, mock_configure: MagicMock, mock_generative_model: MagicMock
    ) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider supports gemini-2.5-flash model."""
        mock_response = Mock()
        mock_response.text = "Response"
        mock_response.usage_metadata = Mock(prompt_token_count=10, candidates_token_count=10)

        mock_model = Mock()
        mock_model.generate_content.return_value = mock_response
        mock_generative_model.return_value = mock_model

        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key")
        response = provider.generate(prompt="Test", model="gemini-2.5-flash")

        assert response.text == "Response"
        # Verify model was called (safety_settings are now included)
        mock_generative_model.assert_called_once()
        call_args = mock_generative_model.call_args
        assert call_args[0][0] == "gemini-2.5-flash"

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.GenerativeModel")
    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    def test_generate_supports_configured_models(
        self, mock_configure: MagicMock, mock_generative_model: MagicMock
    ) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider supports all models configured in config.json."""
        mock_response = Mock()
        mock_response.text = "Response"
        mock_response.usage_metadata = Mock(prompt_token_count=10, candidates_token_count=10)

        mock_model = Mock()
        mock_model.generate_content.return_value = mock_response
        mock_generative_model.return_value = mock_model

        provider = GeminiProvider(api_key="test-key")

        # Test all models from config (config is single source of truth)
        for model in provider.SUPPORTED_MODELS:
            response = provider.generate(prompt="Test", model=model)
            assert response.text == "Response"
            # Verify API was called with correct model (safety_settings are now included)
            call_args = mock_generative_model.call_args
            assert call_args[0][0] == model  # First positional arg is model name

    def test_generate_rejects_unsupported_model(self) -> None:
        """Test that generate() rejects unsupported models."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unsupported model"):
                provider.generate(prompt="Test", model="gemini-1.5-pro")

    def test_generate_validates_max_tokens_minimum(self) -> None:
        """Test that generate() validates max_tokens is at least 1."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="max_tokens must be at least 1"):
                provider.generate(prompt="Test", model="gemini-2.5-flash", max_tokens=0)

    def test_generate_validates_temperature_range(self) -> None:
        """Test that generate() validates temperature is between 0.0 and 2.0."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="temperature must be between 0.0 and 2.0"):
                provider.generate(prompt="Test", model="gemini-2.5-flash", temperature=2.1)


class TestGeminiProviderErrorHandling:
    """Test GeminiProvider error handling and retries."""

    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.GenerativeModel")
    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.genai.configure")
    @patch("src.llm.gemini_provider.time.sleep")
    def test_handles_api_timeout_errors_with_retry(
        self,
        mock_sleep: MagicMock,
        mock_configure: MagicMock,
        mock_generative_model: MagicMock,
    ) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider handles API timeout errors with retries."""
        timeout_error = google_exceptions.DeadlineExceeded("Timeout")
        mock_response = Mock()
        mock_response.text = "Success"
        mock_response.usage_metadata = Mock(prompt_token_count=10, candidates_token_count=10)

        mock_model = Mock()
        mock_model.generate_content.side_effect = [timeout_error, mock_response]
        mock_generative_model.return_value = mock_model
```

```python
"""Tests for Gemini provider (Phase 5.0.4).

Tests verify that GeminiProvider correctly implements the LLMProvider interface,
supports Gemini 3 Flash model, and handles errors appropriately.
"""

import os

class TestGeminiProviderInterface:
    """Test GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""

    def test_gemini_provider_implements_llm_provider(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider implements LLMProvider interface."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert isinstance(provider, GeminiProvider)

    def test_gemini_provider_has_generate_method(self) -> None:
        """Test that GeminiProvider has generate() method."""
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"GOOGLE_API_KEY": "test-key"}):
            provider = GeminiProvider()
            assert hasattr(provider, "generate")
            assert callable(provider.generate)
```

```python
class GeminiProvider(LLMProvider):
    """Google Gemini LLM provider implementation.

    Uses the Google Generative AI SDK to make API calls. Supports retry logic and
    error handling for timeouts, rate limits, and authentication errors.

    def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None) -> None:

        """

        genai.configure(api_key=self._api_key)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        self._config = get_llm_config()

    @property
    def SUPPORTED_MODELS(self) -> set[str]:
        """Get supported models from config."""
        return self._config.get_supported_models("gemini")

    def generate(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_tokens: int = 1000,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
    ) -> LLMResponse:
        """Generate text using Google Gemini API.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt to send to the LLM
            model: The model name (must be one of SUPPORTED_MODELS)
            max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0)

        Returns:
            LLMResponse containing the generated text, token usage, and latency

        Raises:
            ValueError: If model is not supported or parameters are invalid
            RuntimeError: If the API call fails after retries
        """
        # Validate model
        if model not in self.SUPPORTED_MODELS:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unsupported model: {model}. Supported models: {', '.join(self.SUPPORTED_MODELS)}"
            )

        # Validate parameters
        if max_tokens < 1:
            raise ValueError("max_tokens must be at least 1")
        if not 0.0 <= temperature <= 2.0:
            raise ValueError("temperature must be between 0.0 and 2.0")

        start_time = time.time()

        try:
            # Make API call with retry logic
            response = self._call_with_retry(
                prompt=prompt,
                model=model,
                max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
                temperature=temperature,
            )

            # Extract response data
            # Handle cases where response was blocked by safety filters
            text = ""
            if hasattr(response, "text"):
                try:
                    text = response.text
                except ValueError as e:
                    # Response was blocked (finish_reason: SAFETY) or has no content
                    # Check finish_reason for more details
                    if hasattr(response, "candidates") and response.candidates:
                        candidate = response.candidates[0]
                        finish_reason = getattr(candidate, "finish_reason", None)
                        if finish_reason == 2 or (
                            isinstance(finish_reason, str) and "SAFETY" in finish_reason.upper()
                        ):
                            raise RuntimeError(
                                "Google Gemini API blocked the response due to safety filters. "
                                "Try adjusting the prompt or safety settings."
                            ) from e
                    # Re-raise if it's a different error
                    raise

            # Get token usage from response
            tokens_used = 0
            if hasattr(response, "usage_metadata"):
                usage = response.usage_metadata
                tokens_used = (usage.prompt_token_count or 0) + (usage.candidates_token_count or 0)
            elif hasattr(response, "usage"):
                # Fallback for different response formats
                usage = response.usage
                tokens_used = (getattr(usage, "prompt_token_count", 0) or 0) + (
                    getattr(usage, "candidates_token_count", 0) or 0
                )

            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000

            return LLMResponse(
                text=text,
                tokens_used=tokens_used,
                latency_ms=latency_ms,
            )

        except google_exceptions.GoogleAPIError as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Google Gemini API error: {e}") from e
        except Exception as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected error calling Google Gemini API: {e}") from e

        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_output_tokens: int,
        temperature: float,
        max_retries: int = 3,
    ) -> GenerateContentResponse:
        """Call Google Gemini API with exponential backoff retry logic.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt
            model: The model name
            max_output_tokens: Maximum tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature
            max_retries: Maximum number of retry attempts

        Returns:
            Google Gemini API response object

        Raises:
            google_exceptions.GoogleAPIError: If API call fails after all retries
        """
        last_exception: Exception | None = None

        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            try:
                # Create model instance with safety settings
                # Use lenient safety settings for testing/development
                safety_settings = [
                    {
                        "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },
                    {
                        "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH",
                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },
                    {
                        "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT",
                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },
                    {
                        "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT",
                        "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE",
                    },
                ]

                gemini_model = genai.GenerativeModel(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                    model,
                    safety_settings=safety_settings,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                )

                # Generate content
                response = gemini_model.generate_content(
                    prompt,
                    generation_config={
                        "max_output_tokens": max_output_tokens,
                        "temperature": temperature,
                    },
                )
                return response

            except google_exceptions.ResourceExhausted as e:
                # Rate limit error (429) - check for Retry-After header
                retry_after = None
                if hasattr(e, "response") and e.response:
                    headers = getattr(e.response, "headers", {})
                    retry_after = headers.get("Retry-After") if headers else None

                if retry_after:
                    wait_time = float(retry_after)
                else:
                    # Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s
                    wait_time = 2**attempt

                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

            except (
                google_exceptions.DeadlineExceeded,
                google_exceptions.ServiceUnavailable,
            ) as e:
                # Timeout or service unavailable - retry with exponential backoff
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt  # 1s, 2s, 4s
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

            except (
                google_exceptions.Unauthenticated,
                google_exceptions.PermissionDenied,
            ):
                # Authentication errors - don't retry
                raise

            except google_exceptions.GoogleAPIError as e:
                # Other API errors - retry with exponential backoff
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

        # If we get here, all retries failed
        if last_exception:
            raise last_exception
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to call Google Gemini API after retries")
```

```python
    Uses the Google Generative AI SDK to make API calls. Supports retry logic and
    error handling for timeouts, rate limits, and authentication errors.

    Supported models are loaded from config file (config/config.json).
    """

    def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Initialize Gemini provider.

        Args:
            api_key: Google API key. If None, reads from .env file or GOOGLE_API_KEY env var.
                    Priority: explicit api_key > .env file > environment variable.
        """
        self._api_key = self._load_api_key(api_key, "GOOGLE_API_KEY", "Google")

        # Build a client now; the key is required at this point.
        self._client = genai.Client(api_key=self._api_key)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        self._config = get_llm_config()

    @property
    def SUPPORTED_MODELS(self) -> set[str]:
        """Get supported models from config."""
        return self._config.get_supported_models("gemini")

    def generate(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_tokens: int = 1000,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
    ) -> LLMResponse:
        """Generate text using Google Gemini API.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt to send to the LLM
            model: The model name (must be one of SUPPORTED_MODELS)
            max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0)

        Returns:
            LLMResponse containing the generated text, token usage, and latency

        Raises:
            ValueError: If model is not supported or parameters are invalid
            RuntimeError: If the API call fails after retries
        """
        # Validate model
        if model not in self.SUPPORTED_MODELS:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unsupported model: {model}. Supported models: {', '.join(self.SUPPORTED_MODELS)}"
            )

        # Validate parameters
        if max_tokens < 1:
            raise ValueError("max_tokens must be at least 1")
        if not 0.0 <= temperature <= 2.0:
            raise ValueError("temperature must be between 0.0 and 2.0")

        start_time = time.time()

        try:
            # Make API call with retry logic
            response = self._call_with_retry(
                prompt=prompt,
                model=model,
                max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
                temperature=temperature,
            )

            # Extract response data
            # Handle cases where response was blocked by safety filters
            text = ""
            if hasattr(response, "text"):
                text = response.text
                if text is None:
                    raise RuntimeError("Google Gemini API returned no text")

            # Get token usage from response
            tokens_used = 0
            if hasattr(response, "usage_metadata"):
                usage = response.usage_metadata
                tokens_used = (usage.prompt_token_count or 0) + (usage.candidates_token_count or 0)
            elif hasattr(response, "usage"):
                # Fallback for different response formats
                usage = response.usage
                tokens_used = (getattr(usage, "prompt_token_count", 0) or 0) + (
                    getattr(usage, "candidates_token_count", 0) or 0
                )

            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000

            return LLMResponse(
                text=text,
                tokens_used=tokens_used,
                latency_ms=latency_ms,
            )

        except (errors.APIError, errors.ClientError, errors.ServerError) as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Google Gemini API error: {e}") from e
        except Exception as e:
            latency_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected error calling Google Gemini API: {e}") from e

    def _call_with_retry(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str,
        max_output_tokens: int,
        temperature: float,
        max_retries: int = 3,
    ) -> types.GenerateContentResponse:
        """Call Google Gemini API with exponential backoff retry logic.

        Args:
            prompt: The input prompt
            model: The model name
            max_output_tokens: Maximum tokens to generate
            temperature: Sampling temperature
            max_retries: Maximum number of retry attempts

        Returns:
            Google Gemini API response object

        Raises:
            errors.APIError, errors.ClientError, errors.ServerError: If API call fails after all retries
        """
        # Prepare shared configuration
        safety_settings = [
            types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT", threshold="BLOCK_NONE"),
            types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH", threshold="BLOCK_NONE"),
            types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT", threshold="BLOCK_NONE"),
            types.SafetySetting(category="HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT", threshold="BLOCK_NONE"),
        ]

        generation_cfg = types.GenerationConfig(
            max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens,
            temperature=temperature,
        )

        request_cfg = types.GenerateContentConfig(
            safety_settings=safety_settings,
            generation_config=generation_cfg,
        )

        last_exception: Exception | None = None

        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            try:
                response = self._client.models.generate_content(
                    model=model,
                    contents=prompt,
                    config=request_cfg,
                )
                return response

            except errors.ClientError as e:
                # Rate limit (429) or auth errors (401, 403)
                if e.code == 429:
                    # Rate limit error - exponential backoff
                    retry_after = getattr(e, "response", None)
                    if retry_after and hasattr(retry_after, "headers"):
                        wait_time = float(retry_after.headers.get("Retry-After", 0))
                    else:
                        wait_time = 2**attempt  # 1s, 2s, 4s
                    if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                        time.sleep(wait_time)
                        last_exception = e
                        continue
                    raise
                else:
                    # Authentication or other client errors – do not retry
                    raise

            except errors.ServerError as e:
                # Timeout or service unavailable – retry with exponential backoff
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

            except errors.APIError as e:
                # Other API errors – retry with exponential backoff
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    wait_time = 2**attempt
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    last_exception = e
                    continue
                raise

        # If we get here, all retries failed
        if last_exception:
            raise last_exception
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to call Google Gemini API after retries")
```

```python
This module implements the Gemini provider using the Google Generative AI SDK directly.
Supported models are loaded from config file.
Reference: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models

Note: google.generativeai is deprecated in favor of google.genai.
See issue: TODO - Migrate Gemini provider to google.genai package
"""

import time
import warnings

# Suppress deprecation warning for google.generativeai package at import time
# This package works but is deprecated in favor of google.genai
# Migration tracked in implementation plan section 5.0.4
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)
    import google.generativeai as genai
from google.api_core import exceptions as google_exceptions
```
